trap.label: the + comparativo
trap.wrong: More we talk, better we understand.
trap.right: The more we talk, the better we understand.
trap.why: Em português “quanto mais… melhor” não usa artigo. Em inglês, the é obrigatório antes dos dois comparativos.

mcq.q: ___ more we talk, the better we understand.

fix.wrong: More we practice, better we get.
fix.right: The more we practice, the better we get.

fix.wrong: The more we practice, better we get.
fix.right: The more we practice, the better we get.

fix.wrong: It is not so much price than quality.
fix.right: It is not so much price as quality.

rewrite.prompt: Use the…the: “If we practice more, we get better.”
rewrite.answer: The more we practice, the better we get.

rewrite.prompt: Use the…the: “If it is sooner, it is better.”
Use not so much…as: “It is quality more than price.”
